title: Audit Repository and Local Workspace Hygiene
objective: Measure and classify the repository and local workspace using path metadata and bounded reference evidence; propose cleanup, archival and structural improvements without executing them.

executionContract.reasoningComplexity: High: distinguish active runtime dependencies, historical evidence and reconstructible local material without reading media or protected paths.
executionContract.objective: Audit five separate inventory views and deliver three evidence-backed plans with conservative reclaimability.
technicalContext: Work independently ACCEPTED Task 220 and authorized resuming the existing audit, synchronizing coordination, one commit and normal push. The original five outputs plus data/project-coordination-state.json are authorized.
confirmedState: main and origin/main matched the accepted Task220 base at resumption; five untracked Task221 outputs are preserved.
Prior stale coordination blocker is closed by the explicit Work decision; no broad inventory rerun.
branchEnvironment: Windows PowerShell; use npm.cmd. One commit with exact requested message and normal origin/main push.
allowedScope: Reuse existing metadata inventory and local evidence; update audit handoff metadata and authorized coordination state only.
protectedAreas: Reject 005-008 names before stat/open/hash/read; no media content, cleanup, move, regeneration, replay processing or Task 222.
expectedChanges: Five existing Task221 candidate outputs and data/project-coordination-state.json; local Task221 validation/review/attestation.
acceptanceCriteria: Inventory five views, classify all measured files, identify current consumers before classifying local runtime data, report uncertainties and three plans with no deletions.
mandatoryTests: Local audit self-checks, inventory reconciliation, output-scope checks and protected-path guard tests using synthetic names.
requiredEvidence: Per-file metadata/classification/consumer/reproduction/risk/reclaimability records; existing-hash duplicates; group totals; immutable source-tree verification.
commitPolicy: Exactly one commit: Audit repository and local workspace hygiene. Stage only six explicitly authorized files; normal origin/main push. No cleanup/history rewrite.
stopConditions: Protected/media access, cleanup, base divergence or changes outside six authorized files and local Task221 evidence.
returnReportFormat: Measured repository/local totals, three plans, active dependencies, gaps, Git result, gate and Task 221 VALIDATING.

optionalReadPaths: Bounded non-media source/configuration/reference files selected by the metadata inventory; reason: identify consumers, reproduction sources and historical status.
stopConditions: Audit-only; no alteration of pre-existing artifacts except the explicitly Work-authorized coordination synchronization.
